observations: White industrial sewing machine on a metal stand.
Brand 'SUN' is visible on the front of the machine in photo 0.
The machine is shown from a front-three-quarters angle.
A foot pedal is visible on the base.
The machine appears to be in good cosmetic condition.
A watermark 'POSTED ON ABI JUNE' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The photo shows the machine assembled, but there is no video or functional test to confirm it is powered on or running.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The motor may be burnt out or have seized bearings.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running through all stitch lengths and speeds.

risks.risk: The needle or presser foot may be damaged or stripped.
risks.proof: A photo of the needle plate and the underside of the presser foot.

risks.risk: The machine may have a broken or missing foot pedal.
risks.proof: A photo of the foot pedal in operation.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and stitching through all stitch lengths.
Photo of the needle and presser foot.
Photo of the foot pedal in operation.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
